title: USC Career Center: Fall Career Fair and Career Advising
text:
USC Career Center: Fall Career Fair and Career Advising. NOTE: the fair described on this page was Thursday, September 10, 2026, which has already passed as of November 2026. No spring 2027 fair date was found on this page; check Handshake events or careers.usc.edu.

FALL 2026 CAREER FAIR (applies to 2026 only)
- Date and time: Thursday, September 10, 2026, 11:00 am to 3:00 pm PT.
- Location: outdoors on Trousdale Parkway, 'rain or shine.' Employer tables are arranged alphabetically by industry along Trousdale Parkway. Sponsors are near the middle, under red umbrellas near Tommy Trojan.
- Open to all class years and majors, including transfer students. Employers recruit for full-time, part-time and paid internship roles.

REGISTERING THROUGH HANDSHAKE
1. Starting July 1, log in to Handshake and RSVP to the event to view participating employers. Employers register daily, so check back regularly.
2. In Handshake, go to the Events tab, select 'Career fairs at your school,' and choose 'USC Career Center Fall Career Fair 2026.'

PREPARATION
- Bring copies of your resume, your elevator pitch, and your Action Plan.
- Dress in professional business attire.
- Research target employers and prepare questions.
- Bring your own refillable water bottle; water bottles and trash bins are not provided.
- Career Center staff monitor lines; anyone who cuts ahead will be sent to the back.

CAREER ADVISING
- The page links to a Handshake page for scheduling advising appointments. It does not list drop-in hours or detailed booking steps.
- General office hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 am to 5:00 pm. Office: Student Union 110, Los Angeles, CA 90089.

CONTACT
- Career fair questions: recruit@usc.edu.
- Accessibility accommodations: careers@usc.edu (request at least 7 days ahead).
